annotations.title: Facebook Page details: read and edit

description: The public details of the brand’s Facebook Page: about (shown as Description), description (Additional information), website, phone, emails and opening hours. action "get" reads them; action "set" changes only the fields passed and is confirm-gated: without confirm:true it returns the before and after and changes nothing. hours: per day, e.g. {"mon":["09:00-17:00"],"sat":["10:00-14:00","16:00-18:00"]} (two ranges a day at most; a day left out is closed; an overnight close must be before 06:00), or is_always_open:true. Read back from Facebook after a change, naming anything it did not keep. Free.

confirm.description: set: true only after the user agreed to the previewed change

hours.description: per day: {"mon":["09:00-17:00"], …}; or Meta’s own keys {"mon_1_open":"09:00","mon_1_close":"17:00"}

pageId.description: Facebook Page id; omit when only one Page is connected

website.description: https:// link; empty string clears it
